subject: Question about comparing the evolution rate of shape and size

messages.author: 113526e379b7080c
messages.subject: Question about comparing the evolution rate of shape and size
parts:
Dear all,

I would like to perform a statistical test for the difference in evolutionary rate between the Procrustes shape variable and the centroid size. Is the following code correct?

 shape.size <- cbind(two.d.array(Procrustes shape variable), as.matrix(Centroid size))
 gp <- c(rep("shape", p x k), "size")
 compare.multi.evol.rates(shape.size, gp, tree)

The shape variable of the three-dimensional array is made into a two-dimensional matrix, and the centroid size is added as a column.　Using this matrix, I ran compare.multi.evol.rates().

Sincerely,
Naoto Toyoda
